name: Sunfeast Nice, 75 g
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR (26.4%), REFINED PALM OIL, EDIBLE DESICCATED COCONUT, INVERT SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS, STARCH, RAISING AGENTS [INS 503(ii), INS 500(1), INS 450(i)], COCONUT MILK POWDER, IODIZED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [INS 322(i), INS 471] AND FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (INS 223). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR(S) (INS 102, INS 124) AND ADDED FLAVOUR(S) (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES-COCONUT, VANILLA, MILKO CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK SOLIDS, SOYA, NUTS AND SULPHITES.
